root_cause: The production shell readback still required legacy mobile section labels ('ONTDEKKEN', 'KENNIS & BEDRIJF', 'START') after the canonical header had moved to Oplossingen, Koppelingen, Kennis and Het bedrijfsgeheugen. Production was on the exact expected commit, but the stale assertion marked it red.
prevention: Runtime shell assertions must be sourced from the current canonical component contract.
When navigation taxonomy changes, live readback fixtures and assertions change in the same lineage.
A stale verifier may not override exact production identity evidence.
fix: Update the live shell mobile navigation contract and its fixture to the canonical header taxonomy.
